commit.message:
fix(browser): click-select replace for key-ignoring task composers + task-config DB-wait contract (D-M3)

Live-proven (2026-09-19): the agent-task composer on the PRECONVERSATION_ROOT
surface ignores synthetic editing keys entirely - a targeted Backspace was a
no-op and Ctrl+A+Delete never cleared a 26.7k-char account-synced draft of
accumulated fleet task prompts (the CRITIC agent's dispatches kept appending,
never submitting). Enter still submits from that surface (three live
transport proofs).

- SEMANTIC_TYPE verified replace now orders two gestures per surface:
  CLICK_SELECT (native triple-click select-all + one insertText replacing
  the selection) first on the root task surface; KEY_ATOMIC (proven
  Ctrl+A+Delete+insertText) first on conversations
- fail-fast rule: a gesture that neither verifies nor provably no-ops stops
  the sequence - no double-append; a preexisting exact match needs no
  gesture (resume path); an empty composer skips the click entirely so the
  fresh-dispatch zero-geometry contract is preserved
- click-select is self-healing: it replaces a poisoned draft wholesale
- clickBackendNode gains bounded clickCount (1..3); receipts carry
  replace_gesture (CLICK_SELECT / KEY_ATOMIC / PREEXISTING_MATCH)
- new agent-platform-task-config.mjs: New Task control contract (Full-Stack,
  Long-running Tasks, Databases section) + resolveTaskConfigControls +
  waitForAgentPlatformDatabaseVisibility - the bounded perception-only poll
  for the operator note that NEW AGENTS DO NOT SEE ALL DATABASES RIGHT AWAY
  (the DB list populates asynchronously; provisioning must poll, not assume)
- tests: 7 D-M3 gesture contracts + 11 task-config contracts; D-K2 harness
  aligned with the real surface split (Send a Message = conversation URL)

Full suite: 2441 tests / 2434 pass / 5 pre-existing electron-harness fails /
2 skips. npm run check clean.
